messages:
maya.design: Quick design review — I pushed a small variant for the action bar in the console (compact vs comfortable). Wanted feedback on density + contrast before I finalize.
sam.engineering: link to mockup? :eyes:
maya.design: https://figma.com/file/abcd/action-bar-density — top row is compact (8px gaps), bottom is comfortable (12px). Also added a muted state for secondary actions.
jordan.pm: main concern is discoverability for power users. Compact looks great for horizontal real estate but might hide affordances.
alex.a11y: contrast nit: the secondary text color in compact falls below 4.5:1 at small sizes. We should either increase weight or boost the token color.
maya.design: good call — current token is `--muted-600`. If we swap to `--muted-700` the visual looks fine. Any runtime ramifications?
sam.engineering: perf-wise no change. But if we change tokens we should run a quick token audit across the console so we don't break other components.
ui-bot: Reminder: run `yarn tokens:lint` on branch before merging.
maya.design: also thinking about touch targets — the compact action pills are 36px tall. a11y guideline wants 44px min for touch. Thoughts?
alex.a11y: 36px is fine for mouse, but on touch devices 44px is ideal. Can we compromise: keep compact for desktop, switch to comfortable for mobile using `@media (pointer: coarse)`?
sam.engineering: easy to do. We already have a breakpoint hook. I'll add a CSS snippet:

```
.action-pill { height: 36px; }
@media (pointer: coarse) { .action-pill { height: 44px; } }
```

maya.design: perfect. One more — copy on the toast dismiss button currently says `Got it`. Product asked for explicit `Dismiss` in some flows to avoid ambiguity.
jordan.pm: prefer `Dismiss` for system-level toasts, `Got it` is ok for contextual tips. Can we map by type?
maya.design: yes — system -> `Dismiss`, tip -> `Got it`. I'll add variants in Figma and the token sheet.
alex.a11y: also ensure the toast action has an accessible name that includes the toast purpose, e.g., `Dismiss sign-in alert`, so screen reader context is preserved.
maya.design: good catch. I'll update aria-label pattern: `Dismiss ${toastTitle}`.
sam.engineering: I'll wire that up. Also log event `toast.dismiss` with `toast_type` for telemetry.
maya.design: any final call on which density to ship for 1.8? Proposal: default to compact on desktop, comfortable on mobile, and bump muted token to `--muted-700`.
jordan.pm: ship that. Include a rollout note in the release notes about the token change.
alex.a11y: +1 but add a11y regression check in the QA checklist.
maya.design: thanks team — I'll update Figma + PR with the snippets and copy changes. Assigning to @sam for CSS & @alex for a11y review. :thumbsup:
